report.summary: Locked-off wide exterior night shot outside a security gatehouse on wet pavement. A capybara walks in from screen right, stops, and lies down beside the building entrance while a delivery courier finishes business at the window and walks toward his motorcycle putting on his helmet.

findings.observation: A large capybara enters the frame from the right background along the walkway, moving smoothly into the illuminated area near the guardhouse.
The capybara sits and rests on the pavement next to the guardhouse wall while maintaining consistent grounding and lighting contact with the wet surface.
The courier turns around, notices the capybara resting beside him, and begins walking toward the foreground holding his helmet.
The courier lifts his helmet over his head to put it on while walking forward toward the parked motorcycle.
